schema: bench-eval case definitions v2 (issue #81) — v1 contained claims inherited from session notes that the archived bytes did not support; every outcome below was re-read from row.json/result.json bytes on 2026-10-20
purpose: Test inputs defined BEFORE generation: required shape, features, dimensions, relationships, tolerances; provenance per requirement (ink / notes / clarification / frozen policy); classification per the issue.
method: Ink facts read from the source drawing PNGs by vision transcription (never from reference geometry). Notes and the dimension field are the frozen TRIAL-PLAN.json values. Reference measurements come from references/reference-measurements.json and are used ONLY by the evaluator, never sent to the model.

substitutions.requested: a missing-thickness case from the existing corpus
substitutions.reason: The corpus entries that carried the missing-thickness role (missing_thickness, profiles_empty_notes) were deleted in the logged plan revision and predate this record-keeping. 008 is the strongest remaining missing-thickness case: ink shows wall thickness implied only (concentric rectangles), the floor is never drawn, and no numeric thickness exists.

classification_legend.fully_specified: every evaluator-checked requirement derivable from ink+notes+frozen dimension field
classification_legend.requires_clarification: at least one checked requirement absent from ink+notes; the frozen policy stands in for it — NOTE the policy answers only reach the model if it ASKS (ask_missing_dimensions=false in the frozen form; see EV-8)
classification_legend.requires_unsupported_construction: intended shape needs an operation the product path does not expose

EV-3.status: VERIFIED from archived result.json/row.json bytes (product.failures + accepted=false at score 100.0)

The earlier claim was a row mix-up inherited from session notes. The projection check DOES discriminate plate vs bracket on this case.

EV-6.status: VERIFIED from frozen plan bytes (dimension_text null; model.scad constants)

EV-7.where: harness fidelity on 004 (both backends) and wheel (usd t2)
EV-7.claim: the SAME part in two orientations gets opposite fidelity verdicts: 004 openscad (plate on edge, holes facing front) fid=True; 004 usd (plate flat, holes facing up) fid=False with topology 'front expects 3, renders 0 / top expects 0, renders 3'. A view-group assignment baked from one drawing layout penalizes equally-correct orientations; correct parts cannot pass (correct fixture scored 0.30-0.38 < 0.45 min)
EV-7.status: VERIFIED from row.json bytes (identical part, backend-dependent verdicts) + fixture probe

EV-8.claim: ask_missing_dimensions=false and the form carries no thickness field: the frozen policy answers (3 mm) reach the model ONLY if it asks; openscad 004 never asked and silently built 10 mm (GT 5). The run measures guessing, not clarification, and the report must say so
EV-8.status: VERIFIED from request.json form bytes + TRIAL-PLAN clarification_policy bytes

EV-9.claim: 'Construction plan rejected: Unsupported clarification or unknown feature' and 'Expected canonical world frame: X width, Y depth, Z height' — model outputs rejected before any geometry ran; unclear whether model violated a documented contract or the contract is stricter than the recipe documentation
EV-9.status: candidate — needs contract-vs-recipe doc comparison before blame is assigned

discipline: reference geometry was never sent to the model (every request.json records reference_geometry_sent:false)
outcomes are re-read from archived row.json/result.json bytes, never from session notes — v1 claims that failed this re-read are marked in correction_record
unresolved checks are marked unreliable (RECLASSIFY), never deleted; thresholds never lowered to pass existing outputs
cause is never assigned from a screenshot alone: every attribution cites the retained artifact demonstrating the first failing stage
